[[File:BWP.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], and [[Voolvif Monn]] encased in bubble wort projectors]]

Mounted on a variant of the [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droid]], the '''bubble wort projector''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] device used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in battle against [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It projected an orange energy bubble around enemy combatants, thereby immobilizing them. A skilled user of the Force could pop them from the outside, as demonstrated by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 22">{{CW|22}}</ref>
